seoTitle: Check Hostinger Expiry Date & Get 20% Renewal Coupon
metaDescription: Find your Hostinger hosting expiry date in the billing dashboard and learn how to apply a 20% off coupon for a cheaper renewal in 2026.
intro: Losing track of when your Hostinger plan renews can lead to unexpected downtime or a missed chance to save money, so it pays to check your billing details regularly. This guide shows how to locate your next renewal date and apply discount coupons, including a 20% off option, before checking out.

steps.heading: Open the billing section of your dashboard
steps.body: Log into Hostinger and navigate to the billing area where your plan and renewal details are listed.

steps.heading: Find your next renewal date
steps.body: Locate the expiry or renewal date for your shared hosting, VPS, or cloud plan so you know exactly when payment is due.

steps.heading: Apply a renewal coupon
steps.body: Look for available discount codes, including a 20% off coupon, and apply it during checkout to reduce your renewal cost.

steps.heading: Complete the renewal
steps.body: Confirm the discounted price and finish the renewal to keep your hosting active without interruption.

faq.question: Where do I find my Hostinger hosting expiry date?
faq.answer: It's listed in the billing section of your Hostinger dashboard alongside your active plan details.

faq.question: Can I get a discount on Hostinger renewal?
faq.answer: Yes, coupon codes such as a 20% off offer are sometimes available and can be applied at checkout.

faq.question: Does this apply to VPS and cloud plans too?
faq.answer: Yes, the same billing dashboard covers shared hosting, VPS, and cloud plans.

faq.question: What happens if I miss my renewal date?
faq.answer: Missing it can lead to service disruption, so checking your expiry date ahead of time helps you avoid that.
